Every entry needs an `id` (the GitHub advisory id as reported by `pnpm audit --json`), a `reason` explaining why the risk is accepted, and an `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry past its expiry FAILS the gate deliberately, so an exception is a decision that gets revisited rather than a permanent hole.
